context: An elderly couple compares this winter with past years
purpose: Teach: いまや/おくれ/暖かく/例年/短時間/知り合っ/昼寝/甘え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今年の冬はいまや春みたいに暖かくなったなあ。
lines.en: This year's winter has now become as warm as spring.
lines.style: Reflective elderly male voice, slow nostalgic pace with gentle warmth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当に。例年なら、もう雪が積もっている頃なのにね。
lines.en: Truly. In normal years, snow would already be piling up by now.
lines.style: Soft grandmother tone, contemplative and slightly wistful pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 私たちが初めて知り合った頃の冬は、もっと厳しかったよ。
lines.en: The winters back when we first met were much harsher.
lines.style: Warm reminiscing male voice, affectionate and unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 覚えてる。あなた、デートに毎回おくれて来てたでしょう。
lines.en: I remember. You used to be late to every single date, didn't you.
lines.style: Teasing elderly female voice, fond laughter bubbling underneath words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ははは、短時間で支度するのが苦手だったんだ。
lines.en: Haha, I was just bad at getting ready in a short time.
lines.style: Self-deprecating chuckle, relaxed elderly male tone with humor.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近のあなたは、午後になると必ず昼寝してるわね。
lines.en: These days you always take a nap once the afternoon comes around.
lines.style: Gently amused grandmother voice, slightly chiding but affectionate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 歳をとると、つい君に甘えてしまうんだよ。
lines.en: When you get old, you just end up depending on your wife.
lines.style: Tender elderly male voice, honest confession spoken softly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、それでいいのよ。今日もお茶を入れてあげるわ。
lines.en: Hehe, that's perfectly fine. I'll make you some tea again today.
lines.style: Warm loving grandmother voice, contented and caring closing tone.
